name: local-conversation-history
description: >- Entry point for local AI conversation history across Claude Code, Codex, Kimi CLI, and Antigravity (agy): routes each request to its owning reader or continuation skill and keeps cross-provider scope. Use when the platform is unknown or plural ("what was I working on", "we discussed this once") or for Kimi/Antigravity history. Load the owning skill directly when clear.
author: daymade
